items.name: DroneSentry-X Mk2 maritime counter-UAS system
items.claim: DroneShield's DroneSentry-X Mk2 is a ruggedized, IP67-rated counter-UAS detection and disruption system built for topside naval deployment, mountable to the mast or bridge wing of patrol craft, cutters, or auxiliary vessels.
items.source_excerpt: Its architecture provides a ruggedized, IP67 rated counter-UAS capability that can operate topside aboard patrol craft, cutters, or auxiliary vessels without degradation under spray or storm exposure. The single detection and disruption solution is mountable to the mast, bridge wing, or paired with a shock and vibration isolator.
